title: Support for snake case in environment variables can lead to Elasticsearch nodes unable to boot on K8s

labels.name: :Delivery/Packaging
labels.description: RPM and deb packaging, tar and zip archives, shell and batch scripts

body:
**Elasticsearch version** 7.15.0-SNAPSHOT


**Description of the problem including expected versus actual behavior**:

We started testing ECK against 7.15 snapshots and it seems that https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/74327 breaks our tests as we have called many test clusters `es-something`. ECK generates a Kubernetes service for each cluster to expose the Pods to clients and by convention uses the cluster name as part of the service name e.g. `es-something-http`.
 
Now Kubernetes [generates environment variables](https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/services-networking/service/#environment-variables) of the form ES_SOMETHING from those services which will be present in any Pod.   Elasticsearch will pick those up and fail to boot as `ES_SOMTHING_HTTP` this is not a valid setting (I simplified the names a bit here just to convey the idea). 

We could now simply rename our test clusters and avoid naming things starting with `es-*` but I wonder if users will hit this too, once we ship 7.15 if they happen to have any Kubernetes services whose names start with `es-`

**Steps to reproduce**:

* create a simple ECK deployment of Elasticsearch 7.15.0 on a Kubernetes cluster of your choice e.g. 
```sh
cat <<EOF | kubectl apply -f -
apiVersion: elasticsearch.k8s.elastic.co/v1
kind: Elasticsearch
metadata:
  name: es-quickstart
spec:
  version: 7.15.0-SNAPSHOT
  nodeSets:
  - name: default
    count: 1
    config:
      node.store.allow_mmap: false
EOF
```

**Provide logs (if relevant)**:
From an actual e2e test run. Cluster was called `es-naming-xgqf-xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx` (not relevant to this issue but just to explain the funny name: this test case was testing max length validations on names )

```
java.lang.IllegalArgumentException: unknown setting [naming.xgqf.apm.xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx.apm.http.service.port.https] please check that any required plugins are installed, or check the breaking changes documentation for removed settings
```
